Certainly! Here's a professional and constructive feedback template you can use to report to your manager after conducting offline B2B sales with a branch that directed you to the head office:

---

**Subject:** Feedback on Offline B2B Sales Visit to [Branch Name/Location]

Dear [Manager’s Name],

I hope this message finds you well.

I wanted to provide feedback regarding my recent offline B2B sales visit to [Branch Name/Location] of [Company Name]. During the visit, I learned that the location I approached was a branch rather than an independent business unit. The staff at the branch advised me to contact their head office directly for further business discussions.

They provided me with an email address for the head office: [Head Office Email]. I believe the head office would be the appropriate point of contact for decision-making related to our offering.

Please let me know how you would like me to proceed from here. Should I send an introductory email to the head office or schedule a call? Any additional guidance or support would be appreciated.

Thank you for your support.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]  
[Your Position]  
[Your Contact Information]

---

Would you like a more casual or more detailed version?
